data.headline: ORACLE'S ANNUAL MEETING OF STOCKHOLDERS TO BE HELD NOVEMBER 14, 2024
data.summary: Oracle (NYSE: ORCL) will hold its 2024 Annual Meeting of Stockholders on Thursday, November 14, 2024, at 9:00 a.m., Central Time. This year's meeting will be conducted virtually via a live audio webcast at www.virtualshareholdermeeting.com/ORCL2024. Stockholders as of the close of business on September 16, 2024, the record date, are entitled to participate in the Annual Meeting. Guests may also view the Annual Meeting but may not vote or ask questions.
